agent.finish_summary: Fixed WHERE-grouping regression (issue9) by correcting Parenthesis._groupable_tokens in sqlparse/sql.py from self.tokens[1:-2] to self.tokens[1:-1], matching the correct SquareBrackets implementation. This off-by-one previously caused group_where to compute the wrong closing boundary for WHERE clauses nested inside parenthesized subqueries, corrupting the resulting token tree (dropping/misplacing the final real token and the closing parenthesis). Verified manually via sqlparse.parse on nested-subquery WHERE clauses, simple parenthesized WHERE clauses, and IN (...) WHERE clauses followed by ORDER BY — all now produce correct token groupings and round-trip to the original SQL string.
